# C++ fixture provenance

API `.md` fixtures are unmodified copies from
`https://github.com/aspose-words/Aspose.Words-API-References.git`, revision
`8db4485b53d2f6ef08894a005d251db4bd1bebc9`, under `english/cpp/`.
`manifest.json` maps each fixture filename (without `.md`) to its source directory;
the source file in each directory is `_index.md`.

`qt-guide.md` is an unmodified copy of
`cpp/getting-started/work-with-word-documents-in-qt/_index.md` from
`https://github.com/sabir-aspose/words-docs-com.git`, branch
`API-Reference-Aspose-Link-Update`, revision
`c31b4a9631956d8f613475eaac04985c835a28da`.

Source documentation remains Aspose content. Fixtures are retained as regression
evidence, following the Words/.NET baseline's source-fixture approach. They are
not generated C++ examples or a claim that the snippets compile standalone.
